Taoist Master Captures Zhang Fei: The #1 King of Spells in Vietnam

A realm overflowing with evil energy gradually unfolds, where demons lurk in every corner and magical formations blaze amidst the thick fog. You play as a Taoist master walking the line between yin and yang, drawing talismans, setting up altars, and sealing awakened, frenzied spirits.
